page.overview:
Who is Buck Martinez?

Commander Buck Martinez was a male Human Starfleet sciences division officer who lived during the mid-23rd century.

He had a tendency to use malaphors, such as "run it up the flagpole and see if it quacks" and "a watched pot doesn't get the oil."

He was the chief medical officer stationed at Mobile Combat Surgical Unit, a Starfleet hospital located on the moon J'Gal during the Klingon War of 2256‐57. His subordinates included Commander Joseph M'Benga and Christine Chapel. ()
